scope: Frontend shared navigation, language policy, auth feedback and targeted case/reception accessibility. Backend remains at row16.

Page titles, document language and navigation accessible names follow the active locale. Route guards now return values without deprecated next callback.

Skip-to-main link, route content focus, keyboard profile disclosure with Escape/focus restoration and visible focus indicator.
Auth fields have names, required/invalid states, error descriptions and autocomplete. Targeted receipt fields and quantity controls have accessible names.
Receipt report has one main landmark through shared layout; description is capped at backend500characters. Failed case/report actions surface localized alerts.
